name: LAMINAR AIR FLOW (VERTICAL)
desc: Premium Benchtop Vertical Laminar Air Flow Cabinet designed to deliver a Class 100 sterile working environment. Fully constructed from high-grade Stainless Steel 316, featuring integrated HEPA filtration with over 99.97% efficiency and a hermetically sealed glass front door.
features: Main HEPA filter with > 99.97% efficiency at 0.3 μm
Germicidal UV lamp for complete surface decontamination
Microprocessor-based control system with LCD/LED display
Integrated digital pressure gauge with audio-visual alarm

specifications.Equipment Function: Enclosed Sterile Workstation for contamination-free sample handling
specifications.Side Panels Structure: Stainless Steel 316 (LHS & RHS above the work top)
specifications.Air Changes per Hour (ACH): 240 to 480 ACH for rapid contamination control
specifications.Main HEPA Filter Efficiency: > 99.97% efficiency at particle size of 0.3 μm
specifications.Pre-Filter System: Washable Fibre Pre-filter efficient down to 10 microns
specifications.Sterilization System: Germicidal UV Lamp for complete surface decontamination
specifications.Safety Monitoring: Integrated Digital Pressure Gauge with Audio-Visual Alarm
